_about: Each shared operation has one reply fixture per server, local/<op>.json and remote/<op>.json: the reply of the tool named here, for the same collection. Remote replies were recorded from a live anki-sync-mcp (df6a388), except sync and unreachable; media_sync_in_progress was recorded from a2e6562 (PR #22) during a first media download; local ones hold the same notes, ids and texts in the AnkiMCP add-on's reply shapes (evals/mocks/anki). Server-only fixtures are under only. The remote add_created and add_duplicate are batch receipts in the shape recorded from 76f155e (PR #31), with the fixture collection's ids; add_mixed is that recording as is. deck_notes on remote is an include_fields search page (shape from ec9c352, PR #32) of the fixture collection; search_full and search_trimmed (a page cut to fit MCP_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) are recordings from ec9c352 as is. note_type_preview and note_type_updated are a CSS-only update recorded from 853e85b (PR #33). deck_not_found is anki_decks_get(name) for an unknown deck, recorded from b4da2b3 (PR #34). search on remote carries note_type_name (shape from 47c5699, PR #36); search_without_names is the older shape, for the fallback.
